final_text:
16.8% MAC, unchanged. T3.static_margin still fails, so the goal is not met.

Moving the battery aft is the only lever I found that shifts CG enough, and it breaks tier-1 checks. The sweep showed that at x=20 mm the margin reaches 14.9%, but T1.interference, T1.attachment_overlap and T1.attachment_location fail. I reverted the battery to x=0 and confirmed the margin is back at 16.8%.

The remaining options either break tier 1 or are not physically honest. Moving the mass-proxy hardware (hrd-001, hrn-001) aft would work numerically, but it would place real hardware where it can't be. I did not do that. The next step is a `recon` from the conductor on the wing or tail layout, not more data tweaks.

Two things to know: the design has two extra CHANGELOG entries from the battery set and revert, and I used about 7 validate runs against the 10-run budget. I have not opened a PR.
